messages:
alex: FYI PR #8610 (adaptive microbatch tweak) is showing a small-batch p95 regression on the nightly canary. baseline -> PR: p95 42ms -> 88ms. Need a second review or a rollback. Bench artifacts posted.
ci-bot: benchmark-run: https://ci.redwood.example/artefacts/8610/bench-2026-03-17
ci-bot: ```
model: redwood-small-8b-q4
config: small_batch=4 seq=512 iters=200
baseline: p50=28ms p95=42ms mem=3.1GB
pr/8610: p50=29ms p95=88ms mem=3.3GB
notes: kv_miss_rate: 0.07 -> 0.22
```
maya: which workload was used? small_batch=4, seq=512, right?
alex: yes
sam: can you paste the exact bench command?
alex: `./bench/run --model redwood-small-8b-q4 --batch 4 --seq 512 --iters 200`
sam: thanks — I'll repro locally and check scheduler/alloc diff. suspect microbatch alignment change
jordan: if mem up ~200MB could trigger more GC/eviction; can we get heap + allocator stats? ci-bot: heap profile: https://ci.redwood.example/artefacts/8610/heap.prof
liu: +1 to pause the merge until root cause is clear. needs one more runtime approval from eng-runtime
sam: I'll do a deeper run, posting results in ~30m
maya: if we need to revert, target commit is `abc123def` (previous canary)
alex: noted. @sam ping me when you have results. if unresolved by EOD I'll revert to `abc123def`
sam: quick check: seq=128 p95 stable (baseline 35ms vs pr 36ms) — regression is sequence-length dependent. leaning toward kv-prefill/cache interaction
alex: saw traces showing kv_miss_rate jump to 0.22 for affected traces
jordan: trace snippet: `kv_miss_rate: 0.22; kv_prefill_latency: 3.8ms`
sam: will instrument cache hot path and re-run canary
alex: thanks all, leaving PR open but hold merge. :pray:
maya: :thumbsup:
liu: thanks
sam: reporting back in ~25m
